passive_probe.scope: Process includes dual TCP recording, relay, RAM status and periodic health checks; no DSP inference/producer/FR24 connection. Peak RSS includes imports.
passive_probe.limits: Arrival-time difference between independent localhost clients, not RF-to-cloud latency. Slight negative deltas are possible from socket scheduling. No live DSP producer was connected, so this cannot measure real-extra retention or complete-pipeline accuracy.

event_replay.scope: Historical reserved RF, raw candidate regression with energy/CRC/timing/soft/matched only, not full current enabled pipeline or new detections. No model fitting or output forwarding; BroadCRC excluded from callbacks.

limitations: Passive target probe contains original stock only, no live DSP producer
No full-current-pipeline fresh-RF extra-retention validation yet
250ms age gate may reject slow valid results
Stock-first priority cannot retract an already emitted extra; race counted
CPU/RSS includes test recording, health checks and heavy Python imports
Epoch mapping and original producer admission must be integrated before live use
